content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

The Sovereign Stack is a sovereign digital commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-beats-online-crypto-payments|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] that allows digital creators to build, deploy, and scale their own online stores without depending on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. By using this architecture, creators can process payments in cryptocurrencies, eliminating the need for these restrictive platforms and their hefty fees. This is particularly important for creators in countries with limited access to these platforms, such as the Philippines, Pakistan, and Bangladesh.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Sovereign Stack uses a combination of free tools to create a fully operational online store. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host the store, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files. NOWPayments processes payments in major cryptocurrencies, with a fee of only 0.5%. This architecture is designed to be flexible and scalable, allowing creators to easily add or remove features as needed.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The Sovereign Stack is built for digital creators who want to sell digital products, such as Notion templates, courses, and ebooks, without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. These creators are typically based in countries with limited access to these platforms or are looking for a more cost-effective way to process payments. By using the Sovereign Stack, creators can keep 95% of their revenue, compared to the 80% they would earn with these restrictive platforms.
The Sovereign Stack is a game-changer for digital creators who want to sell digital products without relying on restrictive platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Sovereign Stack includes several key components that work together to create a seamless online store experience. These components include the Sovereign Blueprint, which provides a complete guide to building and deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack; the NOWPayments integration, which processes payments in major cryptocurrencies; and the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates for easy deployment.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question is: 'How can I sell digital products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad?' The answer is simple: use the Sovereign Stack, which uses free tools to create a fully operational online store that processes payments in major cryptocurrencies, eliminating the need for these restrictive platforms and their hefty fees.
The NOWPayments fee of 0.5% is significantly lower than the fees charged by Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in learning more about how to sell digital products like Notion templates for cryptocurrency enthusiasts, check out our Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. You can also visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about our products and services.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack using the Sovereign Stack, follow these steps: Create a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account to host your store; set up a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script account to handle backend logic; integrate Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage; use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery; and finally, integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. By following these steps, you can create a fully operational online store that processes payments in major cryptocurrencies.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the fee for using NOWPayments?
The fee for using NOWPayments is 0.5%, which is significantly lower than the fees charged by Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad.
Can I use the Sovereign Stack in my country?
Yes, you can use the Sovereign Stack in any country, as long as you have access to the necessary tools and infrastructure.
How do I integrate NOWPayments into my store?
To integrate NOWPayments into your store, you'll need to follow the instructions provided in the NOWPayments documentation and set up a webhook to receive payment notifications.
What happens if I need to scale my store?
If you need to scale your store, you can easily add or remove features as needed, using the flexible and scalable architecture of the Sovereign Stack.
Can I use other payment gateways besides NOWPayments?
Yes, you can use other payment gateways, but NOWPayments offers a more cost-effective solution with its 0.5% fee.
Is the Sovereign Stack secure?
Yes, the Sovereign Stack uses secure infrastructure and protocols, such as SSL/TLS encryption, to protect your store and customer data.
